detail.longDescription:
NetData App is an unofficial app of NetData

NetData App allow you to connect with your NetData instance and provide you
a system monitoring tool designed to monitor as many services and system resources as possible.

NetData is a system for distributed real-time performance and health monitoring. 
It provides unparalleled insights, in real-time, of everything happening on the system it runs 
(including applications such as web and database servers).

NetData is fast and efficient, designed to permanently run on all systems 
(physical & virtual servers, containers, IoT devices), without disrupting their core function.

With NetData App you can:

- Turn your device into a professional network tool to monitor servers.
- Add as many servers as you can to monitor the real time performance.
- Get comprehensive views of your infrastructure and applications.
- Check process, services & network statistics of each server monitor.
- Add up to 16 monitors of your server.
- Add monitors to check your CPU, LOAD, NETWORK, DISKS, IO and a lot of more.
- Set update frequency for each monitor.

Please don’t hesitate to contact us at hi@kpots.com for any issues or suggestions.
